films.title: Static
films.logline: A radio astronomer intercepts a signal that repeats her own voice from three years in the future, and every attempt to change what it says makes the message clearer.

films.title: The Long Table
films.logline: Two rival food-truck owners are forced to share a single permit for a summer, trading barbs and recipes until they fall for each other somewhere between the tacos and the last night of the season.

films.title: Below the Floorboards
films.logline: After moving into a farmhouse, a family hears knocking from beneath the kitchen every night at 3:12, and the knocks are learning their names.

films.title: Twelve Hundred Hives
films.logline: Over one season, a crew of migrant beekeepers trucks their colonies across four states, filmed as almond orchards bloom and die back.

films.title: Paper Kingdom
films.logline: A hand-drawn adventure about a girl who folds a city out of newspaper and must keep it standing when the headlines start to come true.

films.title: Last Train to Mercer
films.logline: A retired detective boards an overnight train to identify a body, only to realise the passengers are the suspects from the one case he never closed.

criteria.science_fiction: Speculative technology, space, time, or physics that does not exist today.
criteria.horror: Built to frighten: supernatural threats, dread, or violence meant to scare.
criteria.romantic_comedy: A love story told for laughs, with the relationship as the main plot.
criteria.documentary: Non-fiction: real people and events, filmed as they happen or reconstructed from records.
criteria.animation: Drawn, painted, or computer-generated imagery rather than live-action footage.
criteria.crime_mystery: Solving a crime or uncovering a culprit drives the plot.
criteria.other: None of the genres above describes the film well.
